# Shared project policy

Before planning, editing or reviewing, open and follow [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md).
It is the canonical policy for course authority, scope, safety and validation.
Read the task-relevant documents it links; do not invent application commands.
Keep project-wide rules in AGENTS.md rather than copying them into this adapter.
If this Copilot surface cannot read linked files, attach AGENTS.md and the relevant
documents explicitly before proceeding. This file does not configure permissions.
